parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, refer to References: [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).
